title: Xiaomi Mi 9 not connecting with G6
body:
Hi,

Xiaomi Mi 9 not connecting to dexcom g6 transmitter. Tried to move existing xdrip app with current sensor (5 days old) from Samsung galaxy s8 to Xiaomi phone. Copied setting via QR and database via export/import. Logs just show BLE authentication error.

Tried restarting collector and also stopped sensor on old galaxy phone before starting it again on Xiaomi.

Any ideas?

Thanks very much!

comments.body: Think I needed to leave more time to allow the transmitter to reset..? Left it overnight not connected to anything, then it seemed to pair with the new phone. Have had to start a new sensor, but hopefully all good now
